authority_basis.claim_scope: Connected-body problems require consistent system choices, internal/external force accounting and kinematic constraints.

concepts.statement: A multi-body problem may be analysed body-by-body or as a combined system, but internal/external force accounting must match the chosen system.
concepts.why_required: The choice of system determines which forces are internal, which are external, and which equations are legitimate.
concepts.failure_if_omitted: Internal forces can be cancelled in a single-body equation or retained incorrectly in a combined-system equation.

symbols.name: net external force on chosen combined system
total mass of chosen combined system

conditions: Bodies share the declared acceleration constraint

model_conditions.condition: The chosen separate-body or combined-system boundary is declared before force cancellation or summation.
model_conditions.physical_reason: Internal/external classification changes with system choice.
model_conditions.failure_consequence: A force can be cancelled even though it is external to the actual analysed system.

model_conditions.condition: The acceleration relation used between bodies is derived from the physical connection or string geometry.
model_conditions.physical_reason: Connected bodies do not automatically share equal acceleration in every geometry.
model_conditions.failure_consequence: Coupled equations can be solved with an invalid kinematic relation.

representations.semantic_geometry: Separate-body FBDs or an explicitly drawn combined-system boundary are linked by the physical constraint path and consistent acceleration directions.
mandatory_elements: separate-body FBDs or explicit combined boundary
must_not_imply: internal forces may be dropped from a single-body FBD
connected bodies always share equal acceleration magnitude
representations.verification_method: Solve with the chosen boundary, then cross-check separate-body equations and the declared kinematic constraint.

reasoning_sequence.expert_action: Declare whether the analysis uses separate bodies or a combined system before classifying forces.
reasoning_sequence.failure_if_skipped: Internal and external forces can be misclassified.

reasoning_sequence.expert_action: Draw compatible separate FBDs or the combined-system boundary with all relevant external forces.
reasoning_sequence.failure_if_skipped: Forces can be silently omitted or double-counted.

reasoning_sequence.expert_action: Derive and apply the kinematic constraint before solving the coupled Newton equations.
reasoning_sequence.failure_if_skipped: The system can be algebraically solved under an incorrect acceleration relationship.

required_transformations.description: Translate a connected physical scene into an explicit system choice with receiver-specific or combined force models.
Combine the correctly classified force equations with the derived kinematic constraint.

misconceptions.incorrect_model: An internal force may be dropped even when analysing only one member body.
misconceptions.why_plausible: Internal-force cancellation is taught for combined systems and can be overgeneralized to single-body equations.
misconceptions.required_counterexample: Tension is internal to a combined two-mass system but remains an external force on either mass analysed alone.
misconceptions.required_representation_repair: Show the single-body boundaries and the larger combined-system boundary side by side, marking which interaction crosses each boundary.
misconceptions.required_technical_repair: Internal-force cancellation applies only after the relevant bodies are included in the same chosen system.
misconceptions.verification: Re-solve or substitute using separate-body equations and confirm the combined-system result is consistent.

problem_families.name: Connected blocks with shared constraint
problem_families.first_technical_move: Choose separate-body or combined-system analysis explicitly before force cancellation.
fatal_errors: dropping internal force from a single-body equation

problem_families.name: Atwood system as connected-body dynamics
recognition_cues: two masses linked by a string over a pulley
problem_families.first_technical_move: Declare the string model and choose whether to analyse bodies separately or as a combined system.
fatal_errors: mixing signs between the two body equations

falsification_cases.authoring_defect: Allow internal/external force cancellation without a declared system boundary.
